newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore CPI rises 1.6 pct in May year-on-year.
newsitem.headline: Singapore CPI rises 1.6 pct in May year-on-year.

text.p: Singapore's consumer price index (CPI) of inflation was up 1.6 percent in May from the same month last year and up 0.2 percent over April 1997, the Department of Statistics said on Monday.
A Reuters poll of 10 economists last week forecast the CPI had risen 1.9 percent in May from a year earlier.
In April, the CPI rose 1.9 percent from a year ago and 0.5 percent from March.

Note - In May, year-on-year food costs rose 1.8 percent, clothing rose 1.1 percent, housing 1.4 percent, transport and communications 2.6 percent, education and stationery 1.6 percent, health 3.1 percent and miscellaneous costs by 0.7 percent.
